chunks: And it was narrated: “He discontinues the talbiyah when he enters the beginning of the Haram.”

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the talbiyah, the ritual invocation recited in ihram

ai.seo_question: When should the talbiyah be stopped during ʿumrah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the performer of ʿumrah and the point at which the talbiyah is to be stopped. It indicates that the talbiyah is discontinued upon entering the boundary of the Sacred Precinct (Haram).
